source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 2 May 1930, p. 11 ("Local elections in Ulster: nominations in Derry; rural district returns")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: BNL 2 May 1930 p11 'Coleraine Rural Council', read in the block image (areas 6-7): 'All the outgoing members were returned unopposed with the exception of Mr. J. Mayrs ... The members of the new council are:-'

note: Triennial election of Coleraine rural district (21 divisions, one member each). Nominations were received by Mr. Samuel Lecky, clerk and deputy returning officer; all the outgoing members were returned unopposed except in Drumcroon, where Mr. J. Mayrs did not seek re-election and Mr. Alexander Moore was returned (Belfast News-Letter, 2 May 1930, p. 11). No division in Co. Londonderry was contested in 1930 (county council: Webb withdrew in Liberties), so there was no poll; the round stays filed on 1930-06-05, a provisional date not confirmed by any paper read. Returned unopposed.
